title: 第54章 我忍你很久了

第54章 我忍你很久了-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

男子拼命挣扎，身体扭动着想要挣脱。

并大声喊道，“我没有，冤枉啊！我要投诉你。”

“冤枉没冤枉查清楚就知道了，不想吃苦头，就跟我走一趟吧！”同时手上用上劲。

疼得小偷龇牙咧嘴，整个人瞬间安分下来。

顾承安拽起小偷，径直拉到车旁，一把将人扔进车辆后座。

他从兜里掏出专用扎带，俯身将男子的双手双脚牢牢捆住，随即关上后车门。

转身坐回驾驶位，打方向、掉头，车辆顺着原路折返。

行驶一段路程后，顾承安将车停在路边，静静等待起来。

十分钟时间一到，操控智能眼镜打开天珠图标，小偷的完整信息在上面显示了出来。

查看了下具体内容，原来对方是个惯偷，专以偷盗电动车电瓶为生，记忆视频信息，清晰暴露其存放电瓶的具体地址。

顾承安默默记下地址，关闭镜片信息。踩下油门，车辆加速驶向能警官所在的位置。

能警官看到去而复返的车辆，立刻快步跑上前，立正敬礼。

“顾警官，有什么需要帮助的吗？”

顾承安抬手按下后车窗，示意后座。

“遇到个偷电瓶的贼，他存放电瓶的地址是下沙村三坊X巷XX号，我不方便处理，交给你们。”

“报告就说是热心群众举报。”

能警官瞬间会意，当即点头应下。

“明白，谢谢顾警官，我会处理妥当。”

随即能警官立刻招呼两名同事，上前将后座的男子拖下车。

顾承安微微颔首，指了指对方胸口的执法记录仪，开口提醒。

“别忘了哦。”

车辆沿北环大道一路向南。

距落马洲大桥还有十二公里。

顾承安单手握着方向盘，脑子里想着一件事。

那个权限，不限地域。

在他第一次看到的时候就有了想法。

不限地域，意味着港岛也在范围之内。

而港岛，有个他惦记很久的人。

说惦记其实不太准确。

应该说……。

以前没辙。

现在？

顾承安不自觉的一笑，露出一口大白牙。

The man struggled desperately, twisting his body to get free.

And shouted loudly, "I didn't, it's unfair! I want to file a complaint against you."

"We will find out if we have been wronged or not. If you don't want to suffer, just come with me!" At the same time, he used strength in his hands.

The thief grimaced in pain, and his whole body instantly calmed down.

Gu Chengan picked up the thief, pulled him straight to the car, and threw him into the back seat of the vehicle.

He took out the special zip ties from his pocket, leaned over and tied the man's hands and feet tightly, and then closed the rear door.

He turned around and sat back in the driver's seat, turned around, turned around, and the vehicle returned along the original road.

After driving for a while, Gu Chengan parked the car on the side of the road and waited quietly.

When the ten minutes are up, control the smart glasses to open the Dzi Bead icon, and the thief's complete information is displayed on it.

After checking the specific content, it turned out that the other party was a habitual thief who made a living by stealing electric vehicle batteries. He memorized the video information and clearly exposed the specific address where he stored the batteries.

Gu Chengan silently wrote down the address and closed the lens information.Stepping on the accelerator, the vehicle accelerated towards Officer Noh's location.

When Officer Noh saw the returning vehicle, he immediately ran forward quickly and stood at attention to salute.

"Officer Gu, do you need any help?"

Gu Chengan raised his hand and pressed the rear window, indicating the back seat.

"I met a thief who stole batteries. The address where he stored the batteries is No. XX, Lane X, Sanfang, Xiasha Village. It's not convenient for me to handle it, so I'll leave it to you."

"The report said it was reported by the enthusiastic masses."

Officer Neng understood instantly and nodded immediately.

"Understood, thank you, Officer Gu, I will handle it properly."

Immediately, the police officer immediately called two colleagues, stepped forward and dragged the man in the back seat out of the car.

Gu Chengan nodded slightly, pointed to the law enforcement recorder on the other person's chest, and spoke as a reminder.

"Don't forget it."

The vehicle was heading south along Beihuan Avenue.

There are still twelve kilometers to the Lok Ma Chau Bridge.

Gu Chengan held the steering wheel with one hand and was thinking about one thing.

That authority is not limited to regions.

The idea came to him when he first saw it.

There is no geographical limit, which means Hong Kong Island is also within the scope.

And in Hong Kong Island, there was someone he had missed for a long time.

It's not quite accurate to say that I miss you.

It should be said….

Nothing happened before.

Now?

Gu Chengan smiled unconsciously, showing his big white teeth.
